title: Evacuation choreography + chaos rehearsals for Private VPC clusters (IaC-driven)
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Purpose: Build and validate an automated, repeatable evacuation choreography for Private (VPC) deployments that can be executed via Terraform/CI to run regular chaos rehearsals and multi-region failover exercises. Scope: private clusters deployed across two regions (primary and secondary) using our Private control plane. Deliverables: 1) Terraform modules + CI job that perform a safe regional evacuation (drain, snapshot, re-route) against a non-production replica; 2) smoke/synthetic checks that verify functional traffic after switchover; 3) a step-by-step runbook and automated rollback paths; 4) secrets/KMS handling and remote-state safety checks; 5) observability playbook (what to monitor during drills). Out-of-scope: full production evacuation without SRE approval (we will run progressively larger rehearsals).
acceptance_criteria: CI-driven evacuation job can be triggered and completes end-to-end against staging with no manual steps
Post-evacuation smoke tests show <1% error rate on synthetic calls and token-generation latency within SLOs
Terraform modules include pre-checks for remote state locks, region capacity, and KMS key availability
Runbook documents manual intervention steps and a tested automated rollback that rebinds DNS and KMS keys
At least one rehearsal executed with cross-org observers and an incident retro with action items created
steps: Design choreography: drain listeners -> stop accepting new traffic -> export KV cache snapshot -> orchestrate DNS TTL swap -> warm secondary caches -> route canary traffic -> ramp traffic -> monitor metrics -> finalize or rollback
Author Terraform modules that encapsulate evacuation steps as idempotent resources and use remote-state awareness
Implement GitHub Actions job 'drill/private-evacuate' which validates state, obtains confirmation token, runs plan+apply in a sandbox workspace
Create smoke test suite (python + k6) that runs as part of post-apply validations and fails the job on regressions
Add preflight checks: region quota, IP ranges, KMS keys, VPC peering routes, and Vault token validity
Coordinate a rehearsal with SRE, Support, and Customer Success; capture metrics and a postmortem
decisions: Use Terraform modules for orchestration instead of a bespoke operator to keep parity with customer IaC
Perform rehearsals against dedicated staging clusters rather than production until we've completed three successful runs
DNS strategy: use weighted DNS + low TTL (30s) for canary then flip to 100% on success; Route53 failover policy kept as fallback
KMS/Secrets: do not rotate customer-managed keys during drills; use staging KMS aliases and ensure CMKs are present in secondary region
Remote state: require a replication-check step to ensure backend state is read-only/locked before apply
